name: Missed inquiries
problem: Ava asked for a quote for 50 storage boxes. Her inquiry has been waiting for 26 hours.
issue_title: Prepare a reply to Ava’s missed inquiry
source: Gmail, a CRM or Google Sheets
result: Save an approved reply in the demo outbox
sample_draft: Hi Ava, sorry for the delay replying to your request for 50 storage boxes. Our team will prepare a quote and follow up with you.
draft_instruction: Write the customer-facing reply to Ava herself, not instructions to a colleague.

name: Unpaid invoices
problem: Three invoices and two bank payments arrived. One invoice is overdue and needs a reminder.
issue_title: Review the overdue invoice for Northstar Studio
source: Your accounting system and bank statement
result: Save an approved reminder in the demo outbox
sample_draft: Hello Northstar Studio, our records show invoice INV-103 for EUR 450 is still unpaid, seven days after its due date. Please let us know if payment is already on its way.
draft_instruction: Write the payment reminder addressed directly to Northstar Studio. Include invoice ID, amount, currency and days overdue. Do not tell a colleague to send a reminder.

name: Form delivery
problem: A customer submitted the contact form. The form accepted it, but the delivery log has no matching entry.
issue_title: Restore delivery for the demo contact form
source: Your form endpoint, mail delivery log or analytics events
result: Deliver the missing demo submission and verify the receipt
sample_draft: The form accepted submission FORM-103, but it is missing from the delivery log. Repair the local demo route and verify that the submission reaches the demo inbox.
draft_instruction: Write an internal diagnosis and a local repair plan, not a customer reply.

name: Refund opportunities
problem: Five parcels were delivered. One arrived two days late and its demo claim window closes in three days.
issue_title: Prepare the late-delivery claim for SHIP-105
source: Your carrier API or shipping export
result: Save approved claim evidence as a local file
sample_draft: Please review parcel SHIP-105, which was delivered two days later than the promised date. The sample service guarantee allows a EUR 18 claim; delivery evidence is attached to this demo claim.
draft_instruction: Write a claim proposal addressed to the carrier. Include parcel ID, lateness, claim window and refund amount with currency. Do not claim submission or payment has happened.
